_note: Policy maps task types to tier NAMES, never to models. Swapping a model is a change here plus a version bump.

cheap.evidence: Publicly priced at $0.075/$0.30 per 1M. Chosen over llama-3.1-8b-instant, which the repo evidences but Groq does not publicly price.

mid.evidence: Publicly priced at $0.15/$0.60 per 1M. Exactly 2x the cheap tier.

strong._limits_source: UNCONFIRMED -- read the context window for qwen/qwen3.8-27b from https://console.groq.com/docs/models and correct this number. One read of that page reported 131,042, which looks like a transcription slip.
strong.evidence: Publicly priced at $0.80/$4.00 per 1M (console.groq.com/docs/models, read 2026-09-17). Replaces qwen/qwen3.6-27b, which returned 404 'does not exist or you do not have access' on 2026-09-17 after two successful calls on 2026-09-10; it is no longer in Groq's model list. Groq's deprecation page still recommends 3.6 as a migration target, so their docs contradict their API.

pins._note: Task types that must NEVER be routed. Enforced from Sprint 3.

embedding.reason: Embeddings are only meaningful against the model that built the index. Routing them corrupts the vector space silently.
